controls.title: Verify that if OTP or multi-factor authentication factors are lost, that evidence of identity proofing is performed at the same level as during enrollment.

controls.description: Verify that lookup secrets can be used only once.
controls.title: Verify that lookup secrets can be used only once.

controls.description: Verify that lookup secrets have sufficient randomness (112 bits of entropy), or if less than 112 bits of entropy, salted with a unique and random 32-bit salt and hashed with an approved one-way hash.
controls.title: Verify that lookup secrets have sufficient randomness (112 bits of entropy), or if less than 112 bits of entropy, salted with a unique and random 32-bit salt and hashed with an approved one-way hash.

controls.description: Verify that lookup secrets are resistant to offline attacks, such as predictable values.
controls.title: Verify that lookup secrets are resistant to offline attacks, such as predictable values.

controls.description: Verify that clear text out of band (NIST "restricted") authenticators, such as SMS or PSTN, are not offered by default, and stronger alternatives such as push notifications are offered first.
controls.title: Verify that clear text out of band (NIST "restricted") authenticators, such as SMS or PSTN, are not offered by default, and stronger alternatives such as push notifications are offered first.

controls.description: Verify that the out of band verifier expires out of band authentication requests, codes, or tokens after 10 minutes.
controls.title: Verify that the out of band verifier expires out of band authentication requests, codes, or tokens after 10 minutes.

controls.description: Verify that the out of band verifier authentication requests, codes, or tokens are only usable once, and only for the original authentication request.
controls.title: Verify that the out of band verifier authentication requests, codes, or tokens are only usable once, and only for the original authentication request.

controls.description: Verify that the out of band authenticator and verifier communicates over a secure independent channel.
controls.title: Verify that the out of band authenticator and verifier communicates over a secure independent channel.

controls.description: Verify that the out of band verifier retains only a hashed version of the authentication code.
controls.title: Verify that the out of band verifier retains only a hashed version of the authentication code.

controls.description: Verify that the initial authentication code is generated by a secure random number generator, containing at least 20 bits of entropy (typically a six digital random number is sufficient).
controls.title: Verify that the initial authentication code is generated by a secure random number generator, containing at least 20 bits of entropy (typically a six digital random number is sufficient).

controls.description: Verify that time-based OTPs have a defined lifetime before expiring.
controls.title: Verify that time-based OTPs have a defined lifetime before expiring.

controls.description: Verify that symmetric keys used to verify submitted OTPs are highly protected, such as by using a hardware security module or secure operating system based key storage.
controls.title: Verify that symmetric keys used to verify submitted OTPs are highly protected, such as by using a hardware security module or secure operating system based key storage.

controls.description: Verify that approved cryptographic algorithms are used in the generation, seeding, and verification of OTPs.
controls.title: Verify that approved cryptographic algorithms are used in the generation, seeding, and verification of OTPs.

controls.description: Verify that time-based OTP can be used only once within the validity period.
controls.title: Verify that time-based OTP can be used only once within the validity period.

controls.description: Verify that if a time-based multi-factor OTP token is re-used during the validity period, it is logged and rejected with secure notifications being sent to the holder of the device.
controls.title: Verify that if a time-based multi-factor OTP token is re-used during the validity period, it is logged and rejected with secure notifications being sent to the holder of the device.

controls.description: Verify physical single-factor OTP generator can be revoked in case of theft or other loss. Ensure that revocation is immediately effective across logged in sessions, regardless of location.
controls.title: Verify physical single-factor OTP generator can be revoked in case of theft or other loss. Ensure that revocation is immediately effective across logged in sessions, regardless of location.

controls.description: Verify that biometric authenticators are limited to use only as secondary factors in conjunction with either something you have and something you know.
controls.title: Verify that biometric authenticators are limited to use only as secondary factors in conjunction with either something you have and something you know.

controls.description: Verify that cryptographic keys used in verification are stored securely and protected against disclosure, such as using a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) or Hardware Security Module (HSM), or an OS service that can use this secure storage.
controls.title: Verify that cryptographic keys used in verification are stored securely and protected against disclosure, such as using a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) or Hardware Security Module (HSM), or an OS service that can use this secure storage.

controls.description: Verify that the challenge nonce is at least 64 bits in length, and statistically unique or unique over the lifetime of the cryptographic device.
controls.title: Verify that the challenge nonce is at least 64 bits in length, and statistically unique or unique over the lifetime of the cryptographic device.

controls.description: Verify that approved cryptographic algorithms are used in the generation, seeding, and verification.
controls.title: Verify that approved cryptographic algorithms are used in the generation, seeding, and verification.

controls.description: Verify the application never reveals session tokens in URL parameters.
controls.title: Verify the application never reveals session tokens in URL parameters.

controls.description: Verify the application generates a new session token on user authentication.
controls.title: Verify the application generates a new session token on user authentication.

controls.description: Verify that session tokens possess at least 64 bits of entropy.
controls.title: Verify that session tokens possess at least 64 bits of entropy.

controls.description: Verify the application only stores session tokens in the browser using secure methods such as appropriately secured cookies (see section 3.4) or HTML 5 session storage.
controls.title: Verify the application only stores session tokens in the browser using secure methods such as appropriately secured cookies (see section 3.4) or HTML 5 session storage.

controls.description: Verify that session tokens are generated using approved cryptographic algorithms.
controls.title: Verify that session tokens are generated using approved cryptographic algorithms.

controls.description: Verify that logout and expiration invalidate the session token, such that the back button or a downstream relying party does not resume an authenticated session, including across relying parties.
controls.title: Verify that logout and expiration invalidate the session token, such that the back button or a downstream relying party does not resume an authenticated session, including across relying parties.

controls.description: If authenticators permit users to remain logged in, verify that re-authentication occurs periodically both when actively used or after an idle period.
controls.title: If authenticators permit users to remain logged in, verify that re-authentication occurs periodically both when actively used or after an idle period.

controls.description: Verify that the application gives the option to terminate all other active sessions after a successful password change (including change via password reset/recovery), and that this is effective across the application, federated login (if present), and any relying parties.
controls.title: Verify that the application gives the option to terminate all other active sessions after a successful password change (including change via password reset/recovery), and that this is effective across the application, federated login (if present), and any relying parties.

controls.description: Verify that users are able to view and (having re-entered login credentials) log out of any or all currently active sessions and devices.
controls.title: Verify that users are able to view and (having re-entered login credentials) log out of any or all currently active sessions and devices.

controls.description: Verify that cookie-based session tokens have the 'Secure' attribute set.
controls.title: Verify that cookie-based session tokens have the 'Secure' attribute set.

controls.description: Verify that cookie-based session tokens have the 'HttpOnly' attribute set.
controls.title: Verify that cookie-based session tokens have the 'HttpOnly' attribute set.

controls.description: Verify that cookie-based session tokens utilize the 'SameSite' attribute to limit exposure to cross-site request forgery attacks.
controls.title: Verify that cookie-based session tokens utilize the 'SameSite' attribute to limit exposure to cross-site request forgery attacks.

controls.description: Verify that cookie-based session tokens use the "__Host-" prefix so cookies are only sent to the host that initially set the cookie.
controls.title: Verify that cookie-based session tokens use the "__Host-" prefix so cookies are only sent to the host that initially set the cookie.

controls.description: Verify that if the application is published under a domain name with other applications that set or use session cookies that might disclose the session cookies, set the path attribute in cookie-based session tokens using the most precise path possible.
controls.title: Verify that if the application is published under a domain name with other applications that set or use session cookies that might disclose the session cookies, set the path attribute in cookie-based session tokens using the most precise path possible.

controls.description: Verify the application allows users to revoke OAuth tokens that form trust relationships with linked applications.
controls.title: Verify the application allows users to revoke OAuth tokens that form trust relationships with linked applications.

controls.description: Verify the application uses session tokens rather than static API secrets and keys, except with legacy implementations.
controls.title: Verify the application uses session tokens rather than static API secrets and keys, except with legacy implementations.

controls.description: Verify that stateless session tokens use digital signatures, encryption, and other countermeasures to protect against tampering, enveloping, replay, null cipher, and key substitution attacks.
controls.title: Verify that stateless session tokens use digital signatures, encryption, and other countermeasures to protect against tampering, enveloping, replay, null cipher, and key substitution attacks.

controls.description: Verify that Relying Parties (RPs) specify the maximum authentication time to Credential Service Providers (CSPs) and that CSPs re-authenticate the user if they haven't used a session within that period.
controls.title: Verify that Relying Parties (RPs) specify the maximum authentication time to Credential Service Providers (CSPs) and that CSPs re-authenticate the user if they haven't used a session within that period.

controls.description: Verify that Credential Service Providers (CSPs) inform Relying Parties (RPs) of the last authentication event, to allow RPs to determine if they need to re-authenticate the user.
controls.title: Verify that Credential Service Providers (CSPs) inform Relying Parties (RPs) of the last authentication event, to allow RPs to determine if they need to re-authenticate the user.

controls.description: Verify the application ensures a full, valid login session or requires re-authentication or secondary verification before allowing any sensitive transactions or account modifications.
controls.title: Verify the application ensures a full, valid login session or requires re-authentication or secondary verification before allowing any sensitive transactions or account modifications.

controls.description: Verify that the application enforces access control rules on a trusted service layer, especially if client-side access control is present and could be bypassed.
controls.title: Verify that the application enforces access control rules on a trusted service layer, especially if client-side access control is present and could be bypassed.

controls.description: Verify that all user and data attributes and policy information used by access controls cannot be manipulated by end users unless specifically authorized.
controls.title: Verify that all user and data attributes and policy information used by access controls cannot be manipulated by end users unless specifically authorized.

controls.description: Verify that the principle of least privilege exists - users should only be able to access functions, data files, URLs, controllers, services, and other resources, for which they possess specific authorization. This implies protection against spoofing and elevation of privilege. ([C7](https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering))
controls.title: Verify that the principle of least privilege exists - users should only be able to access functions, data files, URLs, controllers, services, and other resources, for which they possess specific authorization. This implies protection against spoofing and elevation of privilege. ([C7](https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering))

controls.description: Verify that access controls fail securely including when an exception occurs.
controls.title: Verify that access controls fail securely including when an exception occurs.

controls.description: Verify that sensitive data and APIs are protected against Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) attacks targeting creation, reading, updating and deletion of records, such as creating or updating someone else's record, viewing everyone's records, or deleting all records.
controls.title: Verify that sensitive data and APIs are protected against Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) attacks targeting creation, reading, updating and deletion of records, such as creating or updating someone else's record, viewing everyone's records, or deleting all records.

controls.description: Verify that the application or framework enforces a strong anti-CSRF mechanism to protect authenticated functionality, and effective anti-automation or anti-CSRF protects unauthenticated functionality.
controls.title: Verify that the application or framework enforces a strong anti-CSRF mechanism to protect authenticated functionality, and effective anti-automation or anti-CSRF protects unauthenticated functionality.

controls.description: Verify administrative interfaces use appropriate multi-factor authentication to prevent unauthorized use.
controls.title: Verify administrative interfaces use appropriate multi-factor authentication to prevent unauthorized use.

controls.description: Verify that directory browsing is disabled unless deliberately desired. Additionally, applications should not allow discovery or disclosure of file or directory metadata, such as Thumbs.db, .DS_Store, .git or .svn folders.
controls.title: Verify that directory browsing is disabled unless deliberately desired. Additionally, applications should not allow discovery or disclosure of file or directory metadata, such as Thumbs.db, .DS_Store, .git or .svn folders.

controls.description: Verify the application has additional authorization (such as step up or adaptive authentication) for lower value systems, and / or segregation of duties for high value applications to enforce anti-fraud controls as per the risk of application and past fraud.
controls.title: Verify the application has additional authorization (such as step up or adaptive authentication) for lower value systems, and / or segregation of duties for high value applications to enforce anti-fraud controls as per the risk of application and past fraud.

controls.description: Verify that the application has defenses against HTTP parameter pollution attacks, particularly if the application framework makes no distinction about the source of request parameters (GET, POST, cookies, headers, or environment variables).
controls.title: Verify that the application has defenses against HTTP parameter pollution attacks, particularly if the application framework makes no distinction about the source of request parameters (GET, POST, cookies, headers, or environment variables).

controls.description: Verify that frameworks protect against mass parameter assignment attacks, or that the application has countermeasures to protect against unsafe parameter assignment, such as marking fields private or similar.
controls.title: Verify that frameworks protect against mass parameter assignment attacks, or that the application has countermeasures to protect against unsafe parameter assignment, such as marking fields private or similar.

controls.description: Verify that all input (HTML form fields, REST requests, URL parameters, HTTP headers, cookies, batch files, RSS feeds, etc) is validated using positive validation (allow lists).
controls.title: Verify that all input (HTML form fields, REST requests, URL parameters, HTTP headers, cookies, batch files, RSS feeds, etc) is validated using positive validation (allow lists).

controls.description: Verify that structured data is strongly typed and validated against a defined schema including allowed characters, length and pattern (e.g. credit card numbers, e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, or validating that two related fields are reasonable, such as checking that suburb and zip/postcode match).
controls.title: Verify that structured data is strongly typed and validated against a defined schema including allowed characters, length and pattern (e.g. credit card numbers, e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, or validating that two related fields are reasonable, such as checking that suburb and zip/postcode match).

controls.description: Verify that URL redirects and forwards only allow destinations which appear on an allow list, or show a warning when redirecting to potentially untrusted content.
controls.title: Verify that URL redirects and forwards only allow destinations which appear on an allow list, or show a warning when redirecting to potentially untrusted content.

controls.description: Verify that all untrusted HTML input from WYSIWYG editors or similar is properly sanitized with an HTML sanitizer library or framework feature. ([C5](https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering))
controls.title: Verify that all untrusted HTML input from WYSIWYG editors or similar is properly sanitized with an HTML sanitizer library or framework feature. ([C5](https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering))

controls.description: Verify that unstructured data is sanitized to enforce safety measures such as allowed characters and length.
controls.title: Verify that unstructured data is sanitized to enforce safety measures such as allowed characters and length.

controls.description: Verify that the application sanitizes user input before passing to mail systems to protect against SMTP or IMAP injection.
controls.title: Verify that the application sanitizes user input before passing to mail systems to protect against SMTP or IMAP injection.

controls.description: Verify that the application avoids the use of eval() or other dynamic code execution features. Where there is no alternative, any user input being included must be sanitized or sandboxed before being executed.
controls.title: Verify that the application avoids the use of eval() or other dynamic code execution features. Where there is no alternative, any user input being included must be sanitized or sandboxed before being executed.

controls.description: Verify that the application protects against template injection attacks by ensuring that any user input being included is sanitized or sandboxed.
controls.title: Verify that the application protects against template injection attacks by ensuring that any user input being included is sanitized or sandboxed.

controls.description: Verify that the application protects against SSRF attacks, by validating or sanitizing untrusted data or HTTP file metadata, such as filenames and URL input fields, and uses allow lists of protocols, domains, paths and ports.
controls.title: Verify that the application protects against SSRF attacks, by validating or sanitizing untrusted data or HTTP file metadata, such as filenames and URL input fields, and uses allow lists of protocols, domains, paths and ports.

controls.description: Verify that the application sanitizes, disables, or sandboxes user-supplied Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) scriptable content, especially as they relate to XSS resulting from inline scripts, and foreignObject.
controls.title: Verify that the application sanitizes, disables, or sandboxes user-supplied Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) scriptable content, especially as they relate to XSS resulting from inline scripts, and foreignObject.

controls.description: Verify that the application sanitizes, disables, or sandboxes user-supplied scriptable or expression template language content, such as Markdown, CSS or XSL stylesheets, BBCode, or similar.
controls.title: Verify that the application sanitizes, disables, or sandboxes user-supplied scriptable or expression template language content, such as Markdown, CSS or XSL stylesheets, BBCode, or similar.

controls.description: Verify that output encoding is relevant for the interpreter and context required. For example, use encoders specifically for HTML values, HTML attributes, JavaScript, URL parameters, HTTP headers, SMTP, and others as the context requires, especially from untrusted inputs (e.g. names with Unicode or apostrophes, such as „Å≠„Åì or O'Hara).
controls.title: Verify that output encoding is relevant for the interpreter and context required. For example, use encoders specifically for HTML values, HTML attributes, JavaScript, URL parameters, HTTP headers, SMTP, and others as the context requires, especially from untrusted inputs (e.g. names with Unicode or apostrophes, such as „Å≠„Åì or O'Hara).

controls.description: Verify that the application protects against XPath injection or XML injection attacks.
controls.title: Verify that the application protects against XPath injection or XML injection attacks.

controls.description: Verify that output encoding preserves the user's chosen character set and locale, such that any Unicode character point is valid and safely handled.
controls.title: Verify that output encoding preserves the user's chosen character set and locale, such that any Unicode character point is valid and safely handled.

controls.description: Verify that context-aware, preferably automated - or at worst, manual - output escaping protects against reflected, stored, and DOM based XSS.
controls.title: Verify that context-aware, preferably automated - or at worst, manual - output escaping protects against reflected, stored, and DOM based XSS.

controls.description: Verify that data selection or database queries (e.g. SQL, HQL, ORM, NoSQL) use parameterized queries, ORMs, entity frameworks, or are otherwise protected from database injection attacks.
controls.title: Verify that data selection or database queries (e.g. SQL, HQL, ORM, NoSQL) use parameterized queries, ORMs, entity frameworks, or are otherwise protected from database injection attacks.

controls.description: Verify that where parameterized or safer mechanisms are not present, context-specific output encoding is used to protect against injection attacks, such as the use of SQL escaping to protect against SQL injection.
controls.title: Verify that where parameterized or safer mechanisms are not present, context-specific output encoding is used to protect against injection attacks, such as the use of SQL escaping to protect against SQL injection.

controls.description: Verify that the application protects against JSON injection attacks, JSON eval attacks, and JavaScript expression evaluation.
controls.title: Verify that the application protects against JSON injection attacks, JSON eval attacks, and JavaScript expression evaluation.

controls.description: Verify that the application protects against LDAP injection vulnerabilities, or that specific security controls to prevent LDAP injection have been implemented.
controls.title: Verify that the application protects against LDAP injection vulnerabilities, or that specific security controls to prevent LDAP injection have been implemented.

controls.description: Verify that the application protects against OS command injection and that operating system calls use parameterized OS queries or use contextual command line output encoding.
controls.title: Verify that the application protects against OS command injection and that operating system calls use parameterized OS queries or use contextual command line output encoding.

controls.description: Verify that the application protects against Local File Inclusion (LFI) or Remote File Inclusion (RFI) attacks.
controls.title: Verify that the application protects against Local File Inclusion (LFI) or Remote File Inclusion (RFI) attacks.

controls.description: Verify that the application uses memory-safe string, safer memory copy and pointer arithmetic to detect or prevent stack, buffer, or heap overflows.
controls.title: Verify that the application uses memory-safe string, safer memory copy and pointer arithmetic to detect or prevent stack, buffer, or heap overflows.

controls.description: Verify that format strings do not take potentially hostile input, and are constant.
controls.title: Verify that format strings do not take potentially hostile input, and are constant.

controls.description: Verify that sign, range, and input validation techniques are used to prevent integer overflows.
controls.title: Verify that sign, range, and input validation techniques are used to prevent integer overflows.

controls.description: Verify that serialized objects use integrity checks or are encrypted to prevent hostile object creation or data tampering.
controls.title: Verify that serialized objects use integrity checks or are encrypted to prevent hostile object creation or data tampering.

controls.description: Verify that the application correctly restricts XML parsers to only use the most restrictive configuration possible and to ensure that unsafe features such as resolving external entities are disabled to prevent XML eXternal Entity (XXE) attacks.
controls.title: Verify that the application correctly restricts XML parsers to only use the most restrictive configuration possible and to ensure that unsafe features such as resolving external entities are disabled to prevent XML eXternal Entity (XXE) attacks.

controls.description: Verify that deserialization of untrusted data is avoided or is protected in both custom code and third-party libraries (such as JSON, XML and YAML parsers).
controls.title: Verify that deserialization of untrusted data is avoided or is protected in both custom code and third-party libraries (such as JSON, XML and YAML parsers).

controls.description: Verify that when parsing JSON in browsers or JavaScript-based backends, JSON.parse is used to parse the JSON document. Do not use eval() to parse JSON.
controls.title: Verify that when parsing JSON in browsers or JavaScript-based backends, JSON.parse is used to parse the JSON document. Do not use eval() to parse JSON.

controls.description: Verify that regulated private data is stored encrypted while at rest, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII), sensitive personal information, or data assessed likely to be subject to EU's GDPR.
controls.title: Verify that regulated private data is stored encrypted while at rest, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII), sensitive personal information, or data assessed likely to be subject to EU's GDPR.

controls.description: Verify that regulated health data is stored encrypted while at rest, such as medical records, medical device details, or de-anonymized research records.
controls.title: Verify that regulated health data is stored encrypted while at rest, such as medical records, medical device details, or de-anonymized research records.

controls.description: Verify that regulated financial data is stored encrypted while at rest, such as financial accounts, defaults or credit history, tax records, pay history, beneficiaries, or de-anonymized market or research records.
controls.title: Verify that regulated financial data is stored encrypted while at rest, such as financial accounts, defaults or credit history, tax records, pay history, beneficiaries, or de-anonymized market or research records.

controls.description: Verify that all cryptographic modules fail securely, and errors are handled in a way that does not enable Padding Oracle attacks.
controls.title: Verify that all cryptographic modules fail securely, and errors are handled in a way that does not enable Padding Oracle attacks.

controls.description: Verify that industry proven or government approved cryptographic algorithms, modes, and libraries are used, instead of custom coded cryptography.
controls.title: Verify that industry proven or government approved cryptographic algorithms, modes, and libraries are used, instead of custom coded cryptography.

controls.description: Verify that encryption initialization vector, cipher configuration, and block modes are configured securely using the latest advice.
controls.title: Verify that encryption initialization vector, cipher configuration, and block modes are configured securely using the latest advice.

controls.description: Verify that random number, encryption or hashing algorithms, key lengths, rounds, ciphers or modes, can be reconfigured, upgraded, or swapped at any time, to protect against cryptographic breaks. ([C8](https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering))
controls.title: Verify that random number, encryption or hashing algorithms, key lengths, rounds, ciphers or modes, can be reconfigured, upgraded, or swapped at any time, to protect against cryptographic breaks. ([C8](https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering))

controls.description: Verify that known insecure block modes (i.e. ECB, etc.), padding modes (i.e. PKCS#1 v1.5, etc.), ciphers with small block sizes (i.e. Triple-DES, Blowfish, etc.), and weak hashing algorithms (i.e. MD5, SHA1, etc.) are not used unless required for backwards compatibility.
controls.title: Verify that known insecure block modes (i.e. ECB, etc.), padding modes (i.e. PKCS#1 v1.5, etc.), ciphers with small block sizes (i.e. Triple-DES, Blowfish, etc.), and weak hashing algorithms (i.e. MD5, SHA1, etc.) are not used unless required for backwards compatibility.

controls.description: Verify that nonces, initialization vectors, and other single use numbers must not be used more than once with a given encryption key. The method of generation must be appropriate for the algorithm being used.
controls.title: Verify that nonces, initialization vectors, and other single use numbers must not be used more than once with a given encryption key. The method of generation must be appropriate for the algorithm being used.

controls.description: Verify that encrypted data is authenticated via signatures, authenticated cipher modes, or HMAC to ensure that ciphertext is not altered by an unauthorized party.
controls.title: Verify that encrypted data is authenticated via signatures, authenticated cipher modes, or HMAC to ensure that ciphertext is not altered by an unauthorized party.

controls.description: Verify that all cryptographic operations are constant-time, with no 'short-circuit' operations in comparisons, calculations, or returns, to avoid leaking information.
controls.title: Verify that all cryptographic operations are constant-time, with no 'short-circuit' operations in comparisons, calculations, or returns, to avoid leaking information.

controls.description: Verify that all random numbers, random file names, random GUIDs, and random strings are generated using the cryptographic module's approved cryptographically secure random number generator when these random values are intended to be not guessable by an attacker.
controls.title: Verify that all random numbers, random file names, random GUIDs, and random strings are generated using the cryptographic module's approved cryptographically secure random number generator when these random values are intended to be not guessable by an attacker.

controls.description: Verify that random GUIDs are created using the GUID v4 algorithm, and a Cryptographically-secure Pseudo-random Number Generator (CSPRNG). GUIDs created using other pseudo-random number generators may be predictable.
controls.title: Verify that random GUIDs are created using the GUID v4 algorithm, and a Cryptographically-secure Pseudo-random Number Generator (CSPRNG). GUIDs created using other pseudo-random number generators may be predictable.

controls.description: Verify that random numbers are created with proper entropy even when the application is under heavy load, or that the application degrades gracefully in such circumstances.
controls.title: Verify that random numbers are created with proper entropy even when the application is under heavy load, or that the application degrades gracefully in such circumstances.

controls.description: Verify that a secrets management solution such as a key vault is used to securely create, store, control access to and destroy secrets.
controls.title: Verify that a secrets management solution such as a key vault is used to securely create, store, control access to and destroy secrets.

controls.description: Verify that key material is not exposed to the application but instead uses an isolated security module like a vault for cryptographic operations.
controls.title: Verify that key material is not exposed to the application but instead uses an isolated security module like a vault for cryptographic operations.

controls.description: Verify that the application does not log credentials or payment details. Session tokens should only be stored in logs in an irreversible, hashed form.
controls.title: Verify that the application does not log credentials or payment details. Session tokens should only be stored in logs in an irreversible, hashed form.

controls.description: Verify that the application does not log other sensitive data as defined under local privacy laws or relevant security policy.
controls.title: Verify that the application does not log other sensitive data as defined under local privacy laws or relevant security policy.

controls.description: Verify that the application logs security relevant events including successful and failed authentication events, access control failures, deserialization failures and input validation failures.
controls.title: Verify that the application logs security relevant events including successful and failed authentication events, access control failures, deserialization failures and input validation failures.

controls.description: Verify that each log event includes necessary information that would allow for a detailed investigation of the timeline when an event happens.
controls.title: Verify that each log event includes necessary information that would allow for a detailed investigation of the timeline when an event happens.

controls.description: Verify that all authentication decisions are logged, without storing sensitive session tokens or passwords. This should include requests with relevant metadata needed for security investigations.
controls.title: Verify that all authentication decisions are logged, without storing sensitive session tokens or passwords. This should include requests with relevant metadata needed for security investigations.

controls.description: Verify that all access control decisions can be logged and all failed decisions are logged. This should include requests with relevant metadata needed for security investigations.
controls.title: Verify that all access control decisions can be logged and all failed decisions are logged. This should include requests with relevant metadata needed for security investigations.

controls.description: Verify that all logging components appropriately encode data to prevent log injection.
controls.title: Verify that all logging components appropriately encode data to prevent log injection.

controls.description: Verify that security logs are protected from unauthorized access and modification.
controls.title: Verify that security logs are protected from unauthorized access and modification.

controls.description: Verify that time sources are synchronized to the correct time and time zone. Strongly consider logging only in UTC if systems are global to assist with post-incident forensic analysis.
controls.title: Verify that time sources are synchronized to the correct time and time zone. Strongly consider logging only in UTC if systems are global to assist with post-incident forensic analysis.

controls.description: Verify that a generic message is shown when an unexpected or security sensitive error occurs, potentially with a unique ID which support personnel can use to investigate.
controls.title: Verify that a generic message is shown when an unexpected or security sensitive error occurs, potentially with a unique ID which support personnel can use to investigate.

controls.description: Verify that exception handling (or a functional equivalent) is used across the codebase to account for expected and unexpected error conditions.
controls.title: Verify that exception handling (or a functional equivalent) is used across the codebase to account for expected and unexpected error conditions.

controls.description: Verify that a "last resort" error handler is defined which will catch all unhandled exceptions.
controls.title: Verify that a "last resort" error handler is defined which will catch all unhandled exceptions.

controls.description: Verify the application protects sensitive data from being cached in server components such as load balancers and application caches.
controls.title: Verify the application protects sensitive data from being cached in server components such as load balancers and application caches.

controls.description: Verify that all cached or temporary copies of sensitive data stored on the server are protected from unauthorized access or purged/invalidated after the authorized user accesses the sensitive data.
controls.title: Verify that all cached or temporary copies of sensitive data stored on the server are protected from unauthorized access or purged/invalidated after the authorized user accesses the sensitive data.

controls.description: Verify the application minimizes the number of parameters in a request, such as hidden fields, Ajax variables, cookies and header values.
controls.title: Verify the application minimizes the number of parameters in a request, such as hidden fields, Ajax variables, cookies and header values.

controls.description: Verify the application can detect and alert on abnormal numbers of requests, such as by IP, user, total per hour or day, or whatever makes sense for the application.
controls.title: Verify the application can detect and alert on abnormal numbers of requests, such as by IP, user, total per hour or day, or whatever makes sense for the application.

controls.description: Verify that regular backups of important data are performed and that test restoration of data is performed.
controls.title: Verify that regular backups of important data are performed and that test restoration of data is performed.

controls.description: Verify that backups are stored securely to prevent data from being stolen or corrupted.
controls.title: Verify that backups are stored securely to prevent data from being stolen or corrupted.

controls.description: Verify the application sets sufficient anti-caching headers so that sensitive data is not cached in modern browsers.
controls.title: Verify the application sets sufficient anti-caching headers so that sensitive data is not cached in modern browsers.

controls.description: Verify that data stored in browser storage (such as localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, or cookies) does not contain sensitive data.
controls.title: Verify that data stored in browser storage (such as localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, or cookies) does not contain sensitive data.

controls.description: Verify that authenticated data is cleared from client storage, such as the browser DOM, after the client or session is terminated.
controls.title: Verify that authenticated data is cleared from client storage, such as the browser DOM, after the client or session is terminated.

controls.description: Verify that sensitive data is sent to the server in the HTTP message body or headers, and that query string parameters from any HTTP verb do not contain sensitive data.
controls.title: Verify that sensitive data is sent to the server in the HTTP message body or headers, and that query string parameters from any HTTP verb do not contain sensitive data.

controls.description: Verify that users have a method to remove or export their data on demand.
controls.title: Verify that users have a method to remove or export their data on demand.

controls.description: Verify that users are provided clear language regarding collection and use of supplied personal information and that users have provided opt-in consent for the use of that data before it is used in any way.
controls.title: Verify that users are provided clear language regarding collection and use of supplied personal information and that users have provided opt-in consent for the use of that data before it is used in any way.

controls.description: Verify that all sensitive data created and processed by the application has been identified, and ensure that a policy is in place on how to deal with sensitive data.
controls.title: Verify that all sensitive data created and processed by the application has been identified, and ensure that a policy is in place on how to deal with sensitive data.

controls.description: Verify accessing sensitive data is audited (without logging the sensitive data itself), if the data is collected under relevant data protection directives or where logging of access is required.
controls.title: Verify accessing sensitive data is audited (without logging the sensitive data itself), if the data is collected under relevant data protection directives or where logging of access is required.

controls.description: Verify that sensitive information contained in memory is overwritten as soon as it is no longer required to mitigate memory dumping attacks, using zeroes or random data.
controls.title: Verify that sensitive information contained in memory is overwritten as soon as it is no longer required to mitigate memory dumping attacks, using zeroes or random data.

controls.description: Verify that sensitive or private information that is required to be encrypted, is encrypted using approved algorithms that provide both confidentiality and integrity.
controls.title: Verify that sensitive or private information that is required to be encrypted, is encrypted using approved algorithms that provide both confidentiality and integrity.

controls.description: Verify that sensitive personal information is subject to data retention classification, such that old or out of date data is deleted automatically, on a schedule, or as the situation requires.
controls.title: Verify that sensitive personal information is subject to data retention classification, such that old or out of date data is deleted automatically, on a schedule, or as the situation requires.

controls.description: Verify that TLS is used for all client connectivity, and does not fall back to insecure or unencrypted communications.
controls.title: Verify that TLS is used for all client connectivity, and does not fall back to insecure or unencrypted communications.

controls.description: Verify using up to date TLS testing tools that only strong cipher suites are enabled, with the strongest cipher suites set as preferred.
controls.title: Verify using up to date TLS testing tools that only strong cipher suites are enabled, with the strongest cipher suites set as preferred.

controls.description: Verify that only the latest recommended versions of the TLS protocol are enabled, such as TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3. The latest version of the TLS protocol should be the preferred option.
controls.title: Verify that only the latest recommended versions of the TLS protocol are enabled, such as TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3. The latest version of the TLS protocol should be the preferred option.

controls.description: Verify that connections to and from the server use trusted TLS certificates. Where internally generated or self-signed certificates are used, the server must be configured to only trust specific internal CAs and specific self-signed certificates. All others should be rejected.
controls.title: Verify that connections to and from the server use trusted TLS certificates. Where internally generated or self-signed certificates are used, the server must be configured to only trust specific internal CAs and specific self-signed certificates. All others should be rejected.

controls.description: Verify that encrypted communications such as TLS is used for all inbound and outbound connections, including for management ports, monitoring, authentication, API, or web service calls, database, cloud, serverless, mainframe, external, and partner connections. The server must not fall back to insecure or unencrypted protocols.
controls.title: Verify that encrypted communications such as TLS is used for all inbound and outbound connections, including for management ports, monitoring, authentication, API, or web service calls, database, cloud, serverless, mainframe, external, and partner connections. The server must not fall back to insecure or unencrypted protocols.

controls.description: Verify that all encrypted connections to external systems that involve sensitive information or functions are authenticated.
controls.title: Verify that all encrypted connections to external systems that involve sensitive information or functions are authenticated.

controls.description: Verify that proper certification revocation, such as Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) Stapling, is enabled and configured.
controls.title: Verify that proper certification revocation, such as Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) Stapling, is enabled and configured.

controls.description: Verify that backend TLS connection failures are logged.
controls.title: Verify that backend TLS connection failures are logged.
